WHAT: ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.neolio42.memory.plist updated to run `bun /Users/ned/Desktop/Projects/memory/src/cli/index.ts serve` instead of global `memory serve` binary
WHERE: ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.neolio42.memory.plist
HOW: After editing plist — `launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.neolio42.memory.plist && launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.neolio42.memory.plist`
WHY: Fork is local; don't want to npm publish for every development change
GOTCHA: The old plist had KeepAlive=true so it auto-restarts — must explicitly unload before relaunching. Also a second `memory serve` process may already be running on port 8765 (check with `pgrep -f memory` before reloading)
